sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale International Distribution of Acetate Eyeglass Frames

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama - national unitary jurisdiction for corporate registration and tax purposes (no material sub-state corporate or fiscal distinctions)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic tradition with Spanish statutory heritage) supplemented by Anglo-American commercial law influence; principal corporate statutes are Ley 32 de 1927 on Sociedades Anónimas, Ley 4 de 1984 on Private Interest Foundations, Ley 23 de 2015 on AML/CFT, and Ley 52 de 2016 on the Final Beneficiaries Registry
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Panama Trade Promotion Agreement with a full Investment Chapter (in force since 31 October 2012)
Canada-Panama Free Trade Agreement including investment protection provisions (in force since 1 April 2013)
Panama-United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement and related investment protection arrangements applicable after the UK's withdrawal from the EU
Panama-Netherlands Bilateral Investment Treaty for the promotion and protection of investments (in force)
Panama-Spain Bilateral Investment Treaty for the reciprocal promotion and protection of investments (in force)
Panama-France Bilateral Investment Treaty on the protection and encouragement of investments (in force)
Panama-Germany Bilateral Investment Treaty on the promotion and mutual protection of investments (in force)
Panama-Mexico Double Taxation Agreement and administrative cooperation instruments (territorial-tax relevance for Panamanian wholesale platforms)

Panama's Global Forum-aligned network of Tax Information Exchange Agreements and double taxation arrangements with OECD and Latin American partners supporting treaty-conscious repatriation planning for wholesale distribution margins

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: National AML/CFT statute: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (prevention of money laundering, financing of terrorism and proliferation financing), as amended by Ley 70 de 31 de diciembre de 2019, implemented principally through Executive Decree No. 363 de 6 de agosto de 2019 (defining subject persons, customer due diligence, PEP and sanctions duties, and supervision of non-financial entities). Beneficial-ownership registry law: Ley 52 de 16 de octubre de 2016, operationalized by Resolution No. SSNF-005-2019 of the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF) and successive amending SSNF resolutions (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales; mandatory reporting applied to all Panamanian legal persons since January 2020). Corporate enabling law: Ley 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (Sociedades Anónimas), as amended; private interest foundation statute (where relevant): Ley 4 de 9 de enero de 1984. Financial intelligence unit: Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF), created by Ley 2 de 13 de enero de 2011 and integrated into the national statistical and supervisory architecture by Ley 23 de 2015.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - the Final Beneficiaries Registry (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) is confidential and non-public; statutory access is reserved to the SSNF, the UAF (financial intelligence unit), the Dirección General de Ingresos (tax authority), the Public Ministry, and foreign supervisory/FIU counterparts acting through recognized international cooperation channels. The resident agent must maintain a private internal UBO file available for on-demand inspection, but the general public enjoys no search right.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) authorizing the Panama resident agent to reserve the corporate name, execute and file the incorporation documents and register the company with the Registro Público
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of the incorporator/UBO, followed by the competent authentication authority in that same jurisdiction (Hague Apostille competent authority or Panamanian consulate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (where the origin country is a 1961 Hague Convention member) OR Consular Legalization at a Panamanian embassy/consulate (for non-Convention jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarial copy of the passport or other government-issued identity document of each shareholder, UBO, initial director and officer (identity verification under CDD rules)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing passport/identity authority of the country of origin; the copy is notarized by a public notary with certification of the holder's signature and identity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization of the notarial certification; the resident agent additionally requires a witnessed original signature page where the notarized copy is not itself apostilled

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing, Certificate of Registration or Corporate Incumbency evidencing the existence and valid authority of any corporate shareholder (if the subscriber is a legal entity rather than an individual)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or designated public officer of the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction (e.g., Registrar of Companies or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, followed by sworn translation into Spanish before a Panamanian authorized translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and AML due diligence questionnaire covering source of funds for the initial paid-in capital, issued by the UBO's existing bank relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution or private bank maintaining the UBO's/incorporator's banking relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille ordinarily required; the bank's responsible officer countersigns the letter under notarized signature; the document is accepted by the Panamanian resident agent as a notarized bank certificate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn translation into Spanish of each apostilled or consularized document (Poder Especial, passport copies, corporate good standing certificates, bank letter)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized sworn translator registered in Panama (traductor juramentado), with notarial certification of the translation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certification in Panama in front of a Panamanian public notary; the translation is the operative exhibit for the Registro Público and SSNF filings

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 1927 (General Corporations Law of the Republic of Panama), as amended; Articles 1–12 governing formation, powers, and share capital; Article 59 regarding officers and resident agent requirements.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section (Public Registry of Panama, Commercial Registry Division)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; a Panama Sociedad Anónima may be formed with authorized capital, and shares may be issued as paid, partially paid, or unpaid. No escrow bank account is required for incorporation capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation hereby accepts the subscription of its authorized share capital, approves the issuance of ordinary shares to the subscribers named in the open ledger, and records all resulting payments or promised contributions; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation is adopted as the address appearing on the formation deed and the resident agent designated in the record is ratified; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed as first officers, each to serve until successors are elected or removed: President, Secretary and Treasurer; and RESOLVED, that the President and Secretary are jointly authorized to execute bank account documents, government registrations, licenses and all corporate instruments necessary to commence lawful operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Online Name Reservation Unit (Portal del Registro Público)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application for name availability and reservation of the proposed Sociedad Anónima name. Pay the statutory name reservation fee and receive an official reservation certificate valid for thirty business days.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (up to three alternatives)
Applicant's valid national passport or identity card
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or marked identical, re-file online with alternative names; no penalty applies. If a provisional rejection is issued, respond within five business days with a written explanation and revised name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Republic of Panama (selected and lawfully appointed notary)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the Panamanian attorney or notary to draft the Escritura Pública de Constitución, including the corporate name, registered office address, resident agent appointment, authorized share capital, bylaws, and initial officers. The incorporators must execute the deed before the notary, and the notary must certify the signatures and issue protocol copies for registration.
required_dossiers: Passport or identity documents of all incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Public Registry later requires corrections, a corrective public deed or clarification statement may be notarized and submitted without nullifying the original incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission and Registration of the Public Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the original notarized Escritura Pública, together with a certified copy and the name reservation certificate, to the Mercantile Section. Pay the applicable registration tariff and await the registry's review of the legal requirements and goodwill screening.
required_dossiers: Original notarized Public Deed of Incorporation
Certified copy of the Public Deed
Proof of payment of registry fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an objection or request for clarification, the attorney must file a formal response within the registry's stated period and provide additional evidence; repeated objections may be cured by a new notarized amendment deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Legal Personality and Registered Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Certifications Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Mercantile Section approves the deed, request certified copies of the Inscripción (registration certificate) and the archived bylaws. These documents evidence the lawful existence of the S.A. and are used for all subsequent government and banking procedures.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate request is delayed or contains transcription errors, request an audit copy and apply to the Registry for correction under the records-rectification procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Employer Identification Number
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministry of Economy and Finance of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the initial tax registration application under the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes). Provide the corporate certificate and designated legal representative information. The DGI will issue the RUC certificate, which is required for municipal licensing and banking.
required_dossiers: Passport or identity of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is flagged for incomplete documentation, respond to the DGI's written notice within ten business days and submit the missing certified translations or copies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operation Notice and Occupational Safety Coordination
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía del Distrito de Panamá – Municipal Operations Directorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Aviso de Operación (business operation notice) to obtain the Certificado de Registro Municipal. Attach the RUC certificate, a copy of the lease or property title, and the fire-safety clearance applicable to the physical office or warehouse. This certificate permits offices to operate legally within the municipality.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or property ownership evidence
Municipal application form and filing fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality refuses issuance based on zoning or occupancy issues, remedy by obtaining a land-use compatibility letter from the local zoning authority or by supplying a corrected lease and floor plan within fifteen business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – wholesale distribution of ophthalmic eyewear frames is not an industrial manufacturing activity and does not require an industrial license in Panama.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operational industrial permit required; only the municipal Aviso de Operación and general tax registration apply.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Category Registration – administrative and wholesale distribution activities with no industrial processing are not subject to a full EIA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emission sources; if warehousing exists, maintain general solid waste management and avoid any on-ground discharge. Comply with applicable municipal wastewater connection standards and manage packaging waste as non-hazardous.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá for any office or warehouse; structural clearance or occupancy permit issued by the municipality; basic occupational health clearance for the workplace as required under Executive Decree 68 of 2008.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); online fiscal portal SIFIL (Sistema de Información Fiscal en Línea).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign shareholders must incorporate the Sociedad Anónima before a Panamanian notary and register with the Public Registry. After domiciliation and appointment of a resident agent and legal representative, the company applies for its RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) and ITBMS registration through the DGI/SIFIL portal or at DGI offices. The DGI issues the RUC and fiscal verification code upon submission of the certificate of incorporation, public-registry registration, and statutes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope: the Sociedad Anónima is taxed at entity level only on Panama-source income; foreign-source income remains outside the Panamanian tax base, and dividends paid to non-resident shareholders are generally exempt.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election is available under Panamanian law. A small taxpayer may elect the Régimen Simplificado de Tributación only if gross annual taxable income does not exceed USD 300,000; a wholesale exporter engaged in international distribution may not qualify. No other material entity-classification election exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS - Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (value-added tax on movable goods and services)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: USD/PAB at par: no de minimis turnover threshold; registration with DGI for RUC and ITBMS is mandatory upon the first taxable transfer of goods or services in Panama.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing through the Sistema de Facturación Electrónica (SIFE) administered by the DGI. Each invoice must be transmitted to the DGI for validation and fiscal authorization via API or portal, and each authorized invoice carries a unique QR code and digital stamp. Export invoices issued to foreign customers must remain SIFE-compliant, with the corresponding export code when applicable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of ophthalmic eyewear frames are zero-rated if the goods are physically exported out of Panama and are supported by a customs exit declaration. Services rendered in connection with the export supply are zero-rated when the recipient is a non-resident and the benefit is effectively used abroad. The zero-rated exporter may credit ITBMS borne on purchases attributable to the exported goods, and any resulting excess credit may be refunded after DGI verification.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA) accepted in the SIGA customs system
Transport documents (Bill of Lading or Air Waybill) evidencing physical departure
Bank payment evidence and, where applicable, inward remittance certificate or SWIFT MT103
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and customs authorities may audit export transactions and ITBMS refund claims within the five-year prescription period. If zero-rating is claimed without real export, the refund is clawed back with accumulated interest and surcharges. Tax fraud penalties apply under Ley 76 de 2019 and Ley 8 de 2021, reaching up to 300% of the evaded tax, plus fines and imprisonment; customs smuggling penalties add confiscation and fines of four to ten times the customs value.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax and Informative Corporate Declaration (Impuesto Anual de Personas Jurídicas y Declaración Informativa de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF), Republic of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fixed calendar deadline: pay and file on or before 15 August of each fiscal year; newly incorporated companies are assessed from the calendar year following incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 5% of the tax if paid within the first 30 days after the deadline, 15% if paid thereafter, plus 1% monthly interest; failure to pay for two consecutive fiscal years triggers automatic administrative strike-off (cancelación de oficio) by the Registro Público.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner and Shareholder Update (Actualización Anual del Registro de Beneficiarios Finales - RBF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - Beneficial Ownership Registry (RBF) via the Virtual Tax Office (Sede Virtual)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation due concurrently with the franchise tax (on or before 15 August); any change in shareholder or beneficial owner composition must be reported to the DGI within 30 calendar days of the triggering transaction.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: For late or inaccurate RBF declarations: fines of B/.1,000 to B/.3,000 for the company and the registered agent, 10% annual interest on overdue corporate tax, and suspension of the registered agent's license for serious non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No automatic audit for a standard Panama S.A. unless (i) gross annual Panamanian-source income exceeds B/.500,000; (ii) the company is licensed as a bank, insurer, SEM (multinational headquarters), or operates in a regulated sector; (iii) the DGI requires audited financial statements as part of a tax examination or administrative order; or (iv) the company voluntarily elects to file audited statements to support financing, procurement, or investor due diligence.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panama National Accounting Rules (NIF) based on International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); books and records must be maintained in balboas/US dollars at parity under the Código Fiscal.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 70 of 2019 and its implementing regulations, every Panama S.A. must identify all ultimate beneficial owner(s) through a sworn statement delivered to the registered agent. The resident agent must file the RBF annually through the DGI electronic platform and recertify the beneficial ownership structure. Any change affecting shareholding percentages, directorships, or UBO status must be reported within 30 calendar days. The annual RBF confirmation is synchronized with the 15 August franchise-tax filing date; non-resident shareholders are fully disclosed to the DGI, but the register remains confidential and is not publicly accessible.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders and Board (Libro de Actas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable when statutorily exempt; quoted at $3,000–$8,000 per engagement if a certified audit becomes mandatory.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: only Panamanian-source net income is subject to the 25% CIT; foreign-source wholesale distribution margins (sales consummated abroad) remain exempt if properly documented. No broad statutory tax holiday for an ordinary Sociedad Anónima, but operations through a SEM (Sede de Empresa Multinacional) or a qualifying free-zone regime may access preferential 0%-5% CIT treatment. Dividends paid out of untaxed foreign-source profits trigger a 20% dividend withholding tax instead of the 10% rate for taxed Panamanian-source profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 — Declaración Jurada Anual del Impuesto sobre la Renta para Personas Jurídicas (Corporate Income Tax Return), filed electronically through the DGI eTax portal at etax.mef.gob.pa
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year S.A., no later than March 31 of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cédula Jurídica / RUC (tax identification number assigned by the DGI)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the 10-digit Panama tax ID issued to the S.A.; foreign shareholders do not enter personal RUCs on this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos brutos de fuente panameña (gross revenue sourced in Panama, including sales delivered or used in Panama)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all Panama-invoiced wholesale deliveries of optical frames; maintain local purchase orders and delivery receipts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos brutos de fuente extranjera (gross revenue sourced outside Panama, legally consummated abroad and not subject to territorial tax)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Staff to attach a foreign-source workpaper showing export shipping terms, foreign-located buyers, and milestones completed outside Panama; keep TI contracts and customs records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costo de venta (cost of goods sold for ophthalmic frame trading)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include cost of acetate frame purchases, freight, and insurance attributable to Panamanian operations; exclude costs allocated to foreign-controlled group purchases in excess of arm's length value.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deducciones y gastos operacionales (operating deductions attributable to Panamanian-source income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only expenses with supporting legal invoices (facturas) or electronic acquisition records; deny allocations from non-resident related parties without a transfer-pricing file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Utilidad gravable (taxable net income after NOL carryforward and deductions)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Positive amounts are subject to 25% CIT; if all income is foreign-source, report zero Panamanian taxable income and attach a detailed basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impuesto causado (tax charge at 25%) and Pagos a cuenta / retenciones (credits for estimated advance payments and withholdings)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply all DGI prepayments and withholding certificates received from Panamanian customers; a credit not traceable to the relevant electronica payment will be rejected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Saldo a pagar o crédito a favor (final tax liability or refundable balance)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay the balance through Panama's fiscal bank network no later than the filing deadline; late clearing after file submission invalidates the return status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax due for each month or fraction of a month, capped at 50% of the tax; unpaid tax accrues statutory interest at not less than 10% per annum; administrative fines of B/. 100 to B/. 5,000 for nil or late returns; failure to pay the final balance may also suspend the corporate 'Aviso de Operación' and block tax clearance certificates for Panama-related customs and licensing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends paid from profits that have already borne Panamanian corporate income tax; 20% on dividends paid from exempt or untaxed foreign-source profits of the S.A.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A foreign shareholder must invoke a ratified Panama DTA by filing an application with the DGI before remittance; the application must attach a current Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the shareholder's competent tax authority, audited proof of beneficial ownership, legalized corporate documents, and the dividend distribution minute. The Panama payer must obtain a prior DGI resolution or confirm the treaty-protected rate before reducing the dividend withholding.

stage_6.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Panama-source royalties on patents, know-how, and trademarks are in practice subject to a 15% gross-basis withholding for payments outside a PE; Panamanian-source interest on financial investments can attract a 10%-15% withholding, but interest on genuine external trade finance or offshore loans used abroad is generally not Panamanian-source and therefore not withheld. Treaty rates, where a DTA exists, typically reduce interest to 5% and royalties to 10% or exempt the income entirely under a business-profits provision.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD / B/. 2,000,000 of aggregate annual gross revenue. A taxpayer exceeding this threshold must prepare a Master File and Local File and file transfer-pricing schedules with Form 210 under Cabinet Decree Rule 47 of 2013.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama does not currently enforce an Economic Substance Regulation comparable to BVI or Cayman for ordinary S.A.s, but DGI applies anti-avoidance and re-characterization doctrines where a Panama vehicle has no local personnel, premises, decision-making, or records. In practice, a wholesale eyeglass-frame distributor claiming foreign-source exclusion must maintain substantive evidence: board minutes approving invoices, local agent or employees, warehouse or e-commerce logistics presence, bank accounts in Panama, and audit-ready revenue records. Free-zone and SEM-licensed entities face statutory economic substance thresholds requiring specific headcount and expenditure in Panama.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion — Consistent Understatement or Artificial Foreign-Source Recharacterization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Treating Panama-consummated optical-frame sales as foreign-source to escape the 25% CIT; issuing post-dated or altered invoices; suppressing cash or platform-payment receipts from Swift_TT/Payment Pay rails; systematically paying no tax despite operations in Panama.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax-fraud penalties of 2 to 5 years imprisonment and a fine of 2 to 10 times the evaded tax; reinstatement of the unpaid tax plus interest and a surcharge of up to 50%; confiscation of bank accounts and goods in the S.A.'s name.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed or approved deliberately false returns can be stripped of the limited-liability shield; civil liability for the entire evaded amount, travel bans, freezing of personal assets, and imprisonment are ordered against the responsible officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the S.A. as a bare booking vehicle for foreign-frame distribution, with no commercial office, no local personnel, no real board meetings, no Panama bank account activities, and no retention of accounting books in Panama while claiming territorial exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI can disregard the lack of substance and reallocate the entire cross-border margin as Panamanian-source, applying 25% CIT plus surcharges and interest; the Public Registry may suspend the entity for failure to renew the fiscal license; administrative fines for each missing annual filing apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: When the corporation is found to be a facade for another operating group, the corporate veil is pierced; the actual foreign controller and the registered resident director are jointly and severally liable for underpaid tax and may face deregistration and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Anti-Money-Laundering Breach in Cross-Border Payments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using bearer shares, undisclosed ultimate beneficial owners, or nominee officers to hide commission income from frame distribution; failing to register the S.A. with the Financial Analytical Unit (UAF), failing to file weighted risk reports and suspicious transaction reports when payments are received from unknown third parties through Swift_TT or platform pay.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 23 of 2015 (as amended): non-monetary sanctions, public reprimand, and administrative fines up to USD 1,000,000 per violation; repeated non-compliance can lead to the forced dissolution of the S.A. and prohibition from opening bank accounts in Panama.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Natural persons managing the AML program face criminal prosecution, asset embargo, and imprisonment of up to 10 years for knowingly facilitating money laundering; the corporate veil is per se unavailable for AML violations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing / False or Undocumented Intragroup Charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Buying acetate eyeglass frames from a related non-resident vendor at inflated prices to eliminate Panamanian taxable margin, or distributing the brand without any documented royalty or mark-up to a connected party, causing a misallocation of dependence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory TP adjustment of the wholesale margin to an arm's length gross profit; a 15% penalty on the adjusted tax undercharge; the undereported income becomes taxable at 25% plus 10%-15% interest; invoices without identification of the supplier and contracts may be denied entirely.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and tax officers who knowingly execute a related-party transaction without an existing transfer-pricing file are personally liable for the resulting penalties and interest in civil proceedings; deliberate non-compliance supports criminal action for fraud and can ultimately trigger resignations compulsory at the Mercantile Registry.
